name: matthew-studio-kit
description: Edit raw talking-head clips into finished Shorts and long-form videos in saved styles. Watch the whole edit live in HyperFrames Studio before anything renders; b-roll, pictures and graphics from your Notion library; QA-gated.

interface.shortDescription: Shorts and long-form, previewed live before they render.
interface.longDescription: Draft, watch each edit live in its own HyperFrames Studio tab, change anything by asking or by hand, then render when you say so. The default look shows the real things you mention, in a clean layout. Say what to tweak and it is saved as a preference on top of that default. B-roll, pictures and sound effects come from your Notion library.
defaultPrompt: Make this a Short from the clip in inbox.
Make this a YouTube video from the clip in inbox.
Make my captions a little smaller.
Add B-roll when I talk about the gym.
Edit everything in inbox and open the previews.
